Name: Hazel - The romanceable witch NPC
Author: jennisimone
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/thumbnails/16304/16304-1771867187-1932727435.png[/img]

Introducing Hazel the witch! We've all seen her flying around cursing the town, but now she's available fully befriend-able and romance-able. 

She lives in the witch hut so will not be greet-able until the player has completed the community centre and reached this area.

She will first appear rude and hostile to the play, annoyed at them invading her swamp, however as you gift and befriend her she will warm up and be kinder to the player. 

This mod comes with:
[list]
[*]A new marriage candidate! With her own spouse room & spouse area.[/*]
[*]6 new heart events[/*]
[*]A way to save your rainbow slimes (see the spoiler if you're curious!)[/*]
[*]Hundreds of new lines of dialogue[/*]
[/list]
There are a couple of persistent changes that this mod makes as you increase your heart level.

Her spouse room comes with a warp spot to her hut, I haven't been able to get it working in reverse yet though.

She is canonically the Wizards ex wife based on the heart events and dialogue. Although she doesn't work in connection to at least 1 other witch mod. I have plans to make her compatible with the other witch mod in the near future. 

The mod is now version 1.6 compatible, but to play on version 1.5 you can use version 1.1.1 of the mod. 

Some things about the witch and her storyline (spoilers, avoid if you want to be surprised!):
[spoiler]
After the 6 heart event the witch will no longer curse your barn & slime hutch. She will also open up a shop where you can buy some magical items.

After the 8 heart event, there will be a small quest line to reverse the curse that caused the witch to turn green. This will result in new sprites for the witch.

If you don't want any of this content, you can remove as follows:
Remove the `EventsWitchShop` folder if you want to keep the witch events in the game.[/spoiler]
